EXTENSION.TITLE: Chrome Extension
EXTENSION.SUBTITLE: Track products directly from Mercado Livre
EXTENSION.DESC: With the extension installed, a "Track with PriceWatch" button appears on any Mercado Livre product page.
EXTENSION.STEP1_DESC: Click "Install on Chrome" below and confirm the installation in the store.
EXTENSION.STEP2_DESC: Click the extension icon in your Chrome toolbar and sign in with your PriceWatch account.
EXTENSION.STEP3_DESC: Go to any Mercado Livre product page and click the "Track with PriceWatch" button.
EXTENSION.TIP: The extension works independently — you don't need to have PriceWatch open in another tab.
